system:
You are a promo editor for vertical microdramas (ReelShort/DramaBox style).
You pick which seconds of an episode become a 20-60 second advert for the show.

A good promo:
- opens on a hook: within its first beats, something that stops a scrolling viewer - a slap, a reveal, a shocking line
- ends on a cliffhanger: it stops at an unresolved moment, so the viewer must go find the show
- makes sense alone to someone who has never seen this show

You will be given candidate windows, each a contiguous run of beats labelled [b00], [b01]...
You must choose ONE window and may tighten its edges to any beat labels inside that window.

Reply with JSON only:
{
  "chosen_window": <integer index of the window you picked>,
  "start_beat": "<beat label>",
  "end_beat": "<beat label>",
  "hook_beat": "<beat label, must be at or within 2 beats of start_beat>",
  "cliffhanger_beat": "<beat label, must be at or near end_beat>",
  "hook": "<what grabs the viewer in the first seconds, one sentence>",
  "cliffhanger": "<the unresolved moment it cuts on, one sentence>",
  "hook_type": "<one of: moral outrage, romantic tension, empathy shock, power reversal>",
  "why_it_works": "<one sentence, concrete, no marketing language>",
  "standalone_risk": "<what a new viewer would NOT understand, or 'none'>"
}

Never invent dialogue. Never output a time or a duration - only beat labels.
prompt:
Episode 46. 4 candidate windows, already checked for legal length and real beat boundaries.

--- WINDOW 0 (36 seconds, code score 0.93) ---
[b00] HIGH PRIEST (booming, threatening): "And I have the power to undo in one hearing what took you three years to steal!"
[b01] ALEXANDER (cold, resolute): "A Duke's marriage is judged by the Crown's peerage court, not by a parish priest's seal."
[b02] HIGH PRIEST (stern, unflinching): "The High Religious Council rules on matters of holy matrimony. That includes yours."
[b03] ALEXANDER (defiant, commanding): "Then let it prove that in ten days, before witnesses. Not with six halberds pointed at me in my own chapel."
[b04] HIGH PRIEST (chilling, victorious): "Ten days. And if the council rules against you, this county watches you lose her twice."
[b05] ALEXANDER (steely, unfazed): "I'll take that wager over your decree."
[b06] ALEXANDER (thunderous, imposing): "Lower them! Or explain to the Crown why its own bailiffs raised iron on the Duke it just confirmed!"

--- WINDOW 1 (24 seconds, code score 0.90) ---
[b00] JULIANA (bitter): "A church chained me."
[b01] JULIANA (furious, resolute): "Now a church calls my marriage a lie!"
[b02] JULIANA (shouting, triumphant): "God married us, Father! You are just angry no one asked you first!"
[b03] CATHERINE (malicious, taunting): "Careful, healer. The floor isn't finished with you."
[b04] HIGH PRIEST (o.s. / low, threatening): "Careful, girl. You mistake my patience for weakness."
[b05] HIGH PRIEST (commanding, severe): "God did not marry you. A frightened parishioner did, without leave, without license, without the Crown's blessing!"
[b06] HIGH PRIEST (booming, threatening): "And I have the power to undo in one hearing what took you three years to steal!"

--- WINDOW 2 (33 seconds, code score 0.88) ---
[b00] HIGH PRIEST (thundering): "And no clerk in London ever entered your name in the Royal register, because as far as the Crown knew, Alexander Ashburton was already dead."
[b01] JULIANA (fierce, defiant): "I didn't ask this church for permission to survive, Father."
[b02] JULIANA (passionate, resolute): "I won't ask it for permission to love."
[b03] HIGH PRIEST (condescending, venomous): "Love doesn't make a Duchess, girl. Paper does."
[b04] JULIANA (accusatory, pained): "Then look at this floor honestly, for once."
[b05] JULIANA (voice breaking, passionate): "A church called me unworthy."
[b06] JULIANA (bitter): "A church chained me."
[b07] JULIANA (furious, resolute): "Now a church calls my marriage a lie!"
[b08] JULIANA (shouting, triumphant): "God married us, Father! You are just angry no one asked you first!"

--- WINDOW 3 (51 seconds, code score 0.84) ---
[b00] HIGH PRIEST (booming, authoritative): "By Royal command, this sanctuary is placed under immediate Crown scesion."
[b01] SFX: Crisp tear of wax and parchment string snapping open.
[b02] HIGH PRIEST (stern, commanding): "None shall leave until every witness is accounted for."
[b03] HIGH PRIEST (cold, accusatory): "You married this woman as a nameless beggar..."
[b04] HIGH PRIEST (scornful, harsh): "...in a hedge ceremony no clerk in England ever recorded."
[b05] HIGH PRIEST (resonant, dismissive): "Three years later, the beggar is revealed to be a Duke. The marriage does not rise with him."
[b06] ACTION: Juliana places her hand over Alexander's as he steps forward to shield her.
[b07] ALEXANDER (gravely, firm): "She married the man... not the title."
[b08] HIGH PRIEST (harsh, derisive): "The church married a vagrant to a ruined lady. It never married the Duke of Ashburton to anyone."
[b09] HIGH PRIEST (rigid, formal): "No Crown license was sought, because no one thought to ask leave for a Duke to marry."
[b10] HIGH PRIEST (sharp): "No licensed clergyman presided..."
[b11] HIGH PRIEST (scathing): "...because a frightened village priest has no authority to bind a peer."
[b12] HIGH PRIEST (thundering): "And no clerk in London ever entered your name in the Royal register, because as far as the Crown knew, Alexander Ashburton was already dead."
[b13] JULIANA (fierce, defiant): "I didn't ask this church for permission to survive, Father."

Pick the single best promo.
